larger = length*0.618, smaller = length*0.382; largerSnapped = snap to nearest m/2, smallerSnapped = length - largerSnapped. Worked-example numbers match SKILL: 4200 → larger 2595.6, snapped 2450, offset 145.6.

evidence: lib/calculations.test.ts:"computeVerticalBands: large band count derived, not capped"
requirements.notes: 25/25 tests green via `node --test lib/calculations.test.ts` (native TS type-stripping, tsx removed per amended ADR-0001). Every exported function has normal + boundary + edge coverage (variable band counts, off-grid openings, 1mm-short dimensions, snap residuals, coprime heights). CR-002 (resolved) reconciled the spec wording to native node:test. CR-003 (low, OPEN): package.json lacks "type":"module" so the runner emits a MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON warning — cosmetic, suite still passes green; deferred to avoid destabilizing the Next 16 build.

Every export is a synchronous pure function — no async, no Promises, no effects, no I/O — so results can update on the same frame as input change. The same-frame UI update is an integration property of the consuming render capability and is not assertable at the engine level; marked tested:false honestly. Structurally guaranteed by the code shape and the NFR-PURE-01 source scan.

Recompute budget <16 ms for ≤20 rooms is met by construction — the engine is O(rooms) constant-work arithmetic (a handful of multiplies/rounds per room; gcd is bounded on two <=5000 integers). No asserting timing test exists (confirmed by SC-004); none is mandated by a spec scenario. Not measured in this session. A benchmark harness is specified as manual/automated case TC-5 in the test plan to close the observation gap.
